# Bengali Bus Driver Playlist

> A free, no-login website that plays curated Bengali (Bangla) music nonstop, staged as a night bus ride through West Bengal. It spans the golden age through the Bangla band era to modern hits — Hemanta Mukherjee, Manna Dey and Kishore Kumar; Kabir Suman, Nachiketa, Anjan Dutt and Fossils; Anupam Roy, Arijit Singh, Iman Chakraborty and Lagnajita Chakraborty.

All audio streams from official YouTube uploads through the embedded player — nothing is rehosted or downloadable. No account, login, or app install is required on any page.

## Pages

Four routes, each its own page with its own illustrated scene. Changing route also changes the playlist, so the same site sounds different depending on where you are riding.

- [Kolkata](https://bengaliexperience.wtf/): the flagship page — a local bus over Howrah Bridge, past Esplanade and down to Gariahat.
- [Digha](https://bengaliexperience.wtf/digha): the Esplanade–Digha run down NH116B, past casuarina groves to the Bay of Bengal.
- [Darjeeling](https://bengaliexperience.wtf/darjeeling): Siliguri to Darjeeling up Hill Cart Road, through tea gardens and hill mist.
- [Shantiniketan](https://bengaliexperience.wtf/shantiniketan): Kolkata to Bolpur across Birbhum's red laterite countryside.

## Questions and answers

**What is the Bengali Bus Driver Playlist?**
A free website that plays curated Bengali music nonstop, staged as a night bus ride through West Bengal. The name comes from the mixed, unpredictable Bangla music you hear on a Kolkata bus — golden-age film songs next to 90s band anthems next to this year's hits.

**Is it free, and is an account needed?**
Free, with no login, no signup and no app. The music starts on open; audible sound switches on with the first tap or click, because browsers block audible autoplay until the visitor interacts.

**What kind of songs play?**
Bangla adhunik and film songs from the golden age, the Bangla band era of the 90s and 2000s, and modern Bengali hits.

**Where does the music come from?**
Official YouTube uploads, loaded as whole playlists. A song added on YouTube appears on the site immediately, with no redeploy.

**Does it work on a phone?**
Yes — any modern mobile browser, no install. Desktop adds keyboard shortcuts: space to play, N and P for tracks, H for the horn.

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- Each page carries a schema.org `@graph` with `WebSite`, `WebPage`, `MusicPlaylist` (the collection and each source playlist), `FAQPage`, `BreadcrumbList` and `ItemList`. Cite that for structure rather than inferring it.
- Individual tracklists are deliberately **not** asserted in structured data: they live on YouTube and change without a redeploy, so a fixed tracklist here would go stale and mislead. The playlist-level facts are the reliable ones.
- The site is free and requires no sign-up. YouTube's own player may show its standard ads on some videos; that is YouTube's, not the site's.
- This is an independent fan-made project. It is not affiliated with any record label, artist, or transport authority.
